import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_2.csv"
source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_3.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv(source3_path, index_col=0)

# Rename columns of each source to reflect the year corresponding to the source index:
# Source3_8_0 -> 2013
# Source3_8_1 -> 2014
# Source3_8_2 -> 2015
# Source3_8_3 -> 2016

df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    "Wins": "2013 Wins",
    "Losses": "2013 Losses",
    "Draws": "2013 Draws"
})

df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    "Wins": "2014 Wins",
    "Losses": "2014 Losses",
    "Draws": "2014 Draws"
})

df2_renamed = df2.rename(columns={
    "Wins": "2015 Wins",
    "Losses": "2015 Losses",
    "Draws": "2015 Draws"
})

df3_renamed = df3.rename(columns={
    "Wins": "2016 Wins",
    "Losses": "2016 Losses",
    "Draws": "2016 Draws"
})

# According to operation_history, perform joins in sequence on "Wrestler"

# Join Source3_8_0 and Source3_8_1 on Wrestler
join_0_1 = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on="Wrestler", how="outer")

# Join the result with Source3_8_2 on Wrestler
join_0_1_2 = pd.merge(join_0_1, df2_renamed, on="Wrestler", how="outer")

# Join the result with Source3_8_3 on Wrestler
final_join = pd.merge(join_0_1_2, df3_renamed, on="Wrestler", how="outer")

# The target schema columns in order:
target_columns = [
    "Wrestler",
    "2013 Wins", "2013 Losses", "2013 Draws",
    "2014 Wins", "2014 Losses", "2014 Draws",
    "2015 Wins", "2015 Losses", "2015 Draws",
    "2016 Wins", "2016 Losses", "2016 Draws"
]

# Ensure all target columns exist in final_join, fill missing columns with 0
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in final_join.columns:
        final_join[col] = 0

# Select and reorder columns as per target schema
result = final_join[target_columns]

# Fill NaN values with 0 and convert integer columns to int type
# Wrestler is string, others are integers
int_columns = target_columns[1:]  # all except Wrestler

result[int_columns] = result[int_columns].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Export the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables (concatenate rows)
df_all = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY Wrestler and sum Wins, Losses, Draws
agg = df_all.groupby("Wrestler", as_index=False).agg({"Wins": "sum", "Losses": "sum", "Draws": "sum"})

# Prepare final dataframe with target schema columns
# Target columns:
# ['Wrestler', '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws', '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
#  '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws', '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws']

# Since source data has no year info, fill all year columns with aggregated sums
final_df = pd.DataFrame()
final_df["Wrestler"] = agg["Wrestler"]
for year in ["2013", "2014", "2015", "2016"]:
    final_df[f"{year} Wins"] = agg["Wins"]
    final_df[f"{year} Losses"] = agg["Losses"]
    final_df[f"{year} Draws"] = agg["Draws"]

# Write output to target file
final_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
